summary: Gold and cattle civ. Malians open with seven houses or a tower depending on the opponent, make Donso and javelin units before cows, and reach Castle after 12 cows.
openings: 7-house opener against civs that don't rush.
Donso and javelin units first, then 12 cows, then Castle.

spikes.label: Javelins and Donso
spikes.detail: Javelin units and Donso arrive before their cow economy.
spikes.answer: Men-at-arms and horsemen; scout for hidden Musofadi.

spikes.label: Pit Mine economy
spikes.detail: A second Pit Mine and cows let them outscale.
spikes.answer: Deny the second Pit Mine and push with siege before they outscale.

scout: A tower on resources means they expect a rush
A second Pit Mine going up

winConditions.detail: Pit Mines and cows that keep producing.

howToBeat: Siege push before they outscale; Macedonians do it around 24 minutes.
